name: Unsloth
description: Fine-tuning library with fused kernels and offloaded gradient checkpointing. The core package is Apache-2.0; optional components such as the Studio UI are AGPL-3.0. CPU support is for chat/data recipes only, not training. Multi-GPU and DeepSpeed ZeRO-2/3 supported; multi-node unconfirmed.
